product_overview: Docs LV is a modern document vault for securely uploading, organizing, previewing, and sharing files. Users connect their own Supabase storage, then manage their files through a premium dashboard with private sharing links for public access.
core_goals: Sign in to access a personal file vault
Connect a Supabase project to enable storage
Upload one or more files into the vault
Preview, rename, and delete stored files
Generate secure share links for files
Open shared links and download files publicly

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Users can sign in or sign up to access their dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /sign-in -> Enter credentials -> Access the dashboard

features.name: Connect Supabase
features.description: Users can add their own Supabase project credentials in settings to activate storage.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/settings -> Fill Supabase URL input -> Fill Supabase Anon Key input -> Save the credentials

features.name: File Upload
features.description: Users can upload single or multiple files into their vault with upload progress feedback.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Add files by dragging and dropping them or selecting them from a dialog -> Start the upload -> View upload progress -> See the upload success animation -> See the vault refresh with the new files

features.name: File Preview
features.description: Users can open a preview modal to inspect file contents before taking further actions.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Open a file preview -> View the file content in a modal -> Close the preview

features.name: Rename File
features.description: Users can rename an existing file in the vault.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Open the rename action for a file -> Enter a new filename -> Submit the rename -> See the updated filename in the list

features.name: Delete File
features.description: Users can delete a single file or multiple selected files from the vault.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Open the delete action for a single file -> Confirm deletion -> See the file removed from the list
Navigate to /dashboard -> Select multiple files -> Open the batch delete action -> Type the required confirmation phrase -> Submit the deletion -> See the selected files removed from the list

features.name: Share File
features.description: Users can generate secure short links for a single file or a batch of files.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Open the share action for a single file -> Copy the generated short link
Navigate to /dashboard -> Select multiple files -> Open the batch share action -> Copy the generated short link

features.name: Public File Download
features.description: Public visitors can open a shared link and download shared files without signing in.
user_flows: Open a shared short link in /s/[token] -> View the shared file page or file redirect -> Download the file
